mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the federal funds rate, reflecting an active monetary tightening cycle, compresses equity valuations by increasing discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is above 5.0% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 0.2 percentage points from the previous month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE rises > 0.2pp, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both residential investment (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signal a broad-based weakening in aggregate demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS (both down > 0.5% from prior month) fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing slowdowns defined by a monthly decline in industrial production exceeding 0.3%, the S&P 500 underperforms as production weakness signals reduced corporate profitability, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when INDPRO falls > 0.3% from prior month, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates strong household demand, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS increases, the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 45% of cases over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index level above 200 (indicating cumulative inflation exceeding 100% since 1982-1984) signals persistent inflationary pressures, prompting restrictive monetary policy that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when CPIAUCSL > 200, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signal dual economic stress: labor market weakness combined with restrictive policy, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When both UNRATE and FEDFUNDS increase from prior month, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates weakening manufacturing output, reducing corporate profits and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The INDPRO decline (monthly change < -0.2%) fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases over a 5-year rolling window.
